item.title: the case for process substitution
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I keep coming back to process substitution, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

Process substitution shows up across linux work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.
  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
